title: PHANTOM GRID Active Anti-Phase EMC Noise Cancellation
full_script: PHANTOM GRID deploys analog front-end active anti-phase noise cancellation. Under extreme 95.5 dBm broadband RF interference, the engine triggers within 30 picoseconds. An exact 180 degree anti-phase wavefront is synthesized, suppressing noise floor to minus 120 dBm. Over 215.5 dB attenuation preserves critical sensor and CAN bus signal-to-noise ratio. All events are immutably signed with SHA-256 and exposed through vehicle MCP tooling.
